mapper.select: SELECT ID, LOCKED_BY, LOCKED_AT, TEMP_TABLE_NAME, STATUS, SUBSYSTEM_CODE FROM perm_menu_edit_lock WHERE STATUS = 'LOCKED' AND LOCKED_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutHours} HOUR)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO perm_menu_edit_lock (LOCKED_BY, LOCKED_AT, TEMP_TABLE_NAME, STATUS, SUBSYSTEM_CODE) VALUES (#{lock.lockedBy}, NOW(), #{lock.tempTableName}, 'LOCKED', #{lock.subsystemCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE perm_menu_edit_lock SET STATUS = 'RELEASED' WHERE TEMP_TABLE_NAME = #{tempTableName} AND STATUS = 'LOCKED'
mapper.select: SELECT ID, LOCKED_BY, LOCKED_AT, TEMP_TABLE_NAME, STATUS, SUBSYSTEM_CODE FROM perm_menu_edit_lock WHERE TEMP_TABLE_NAME = #{tempTableName} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1
